record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly lower learning rate from 7e-4 to 5e-4 and increase dropout from 0.1 to 0.15. Slower optimization coupled with stronger regularization may improve generalization; the regression at dropout 0.05 motivates exploring the opposite direction, without establishing its benefit. Keep dimensions, depth, heads, MAXLEN=128, batch size, Adam, loss and all representation/readout definitions fixed. Preserve seed 42, the 200-epoch cap and 200 batches per epoch.
